sliding_block_m1.name: Block on Inclined Plane (Mass m₁)
sliding_block_m1.description: Mass resting or sliding on the inclined surface, acted on by gravity (m₁g), normal force (N), tension (T), and friction (f).

inclined_plane_surface.name: Inclined Plane (Ramp Surface)
inclined_plane_surface.description: Plane surface inclined at angle θ to the horizontal along which the block accelerates or remains in equilibrium.

incline_angle_theta.name: Angle of Inclination (θ)
incline_angle_theta.description: Acute angle θ between the inclined plane and the horizontal base, used to resolve weight into Fg∥ = mg sin θ and Fg⊥ = mg cos θ.

frictionless_pulley.name: Light Frictionless Pulley
frictionless_pulley.description: Grooved wheel mounted at the apex of the incline that redirects the tension force without changing its magnitude.

inextensible_cord.name: Light Inextensible String (Tension T)
inextensible_cord.description: Massless, unstretchable cord connecting both masses so that both bodies share the same magnitude of acceleration a and tension T.

hanging_mass_m2.name: Suspended Hanging Mass (m₂)
hanging_mass_m2.description: Vertically suspended cylinder acted on only by downward gravitational force (m₂g) and upward string tension (T).
